using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Xunit;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common.Widgets.Logic;
using Moq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests.Widgets.Logic
{
	public class ServerListLogicTests
	{
		// We cannot mock HttpClient.GetAsync directly because it is non-virtual and no interface is used.
		// So we test that RefreshServerList triggers the async call without exceptions and sets activeQuery flag.
		// This is an integration style test that at least covers the call to GetAsync.

		[Fact]
		public void RefreshServerList_DoesNotStartNewQueryIfActiveQueryIsTrue()
		{
			var modData = new TestModData();
			var logic = new ServerListLogic(new TestWidget(), modData, _ => { });

			// Set activeQuery to true via reflection since it's private
			var activeQueryField = typeof(ServerListLogic).GetField("activeQuery", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
			activeQueryField.SetValue(logic, true);

			logic.RefreshServerList();

			// activeQuery should remain true and no exception thrown
			Assert.True((bool)activeQueryField.GetValue(logic));
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task RefreshServerList_StartsQueryAndCallsHttpClientGetAsync()
		{
			var modData = new TestModData();
			var logic = new ServerListLogic(new TestWidget(), modData, _ => { });

			// We cannot directly observe the HttpClient call, but we can check that activeQuery is set to true after call
			var activeQueryField = typeof(ServerListLogic).GetField("activeQuery", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);

			logic.RefreshServerList();

			// Wait a bit for the async Task.Run to start and set activeQuery
			await Task.Delay(100);

			Assert.True((bool)activeQueryField.GetValue(logic));
		}

		// Minimal stub classes to satisfy constructor dependencies
		class TestModData : OpenRA.ModData
		{
			public override T GetOrCreate<T>()
			{
				if (typeof(T) == typeof(OpenRA.Mods.Common.Widgets.Logic.WebServices))
					return (T)(object)new OpenRA.Mods.Common.Widgets.Logic.WebServices();
				return base.GetOrCreate<T>();
			}
		}

		class TestWidget : OpenRA.Widgets.Widget
		{
			public override T Get<T>(string name) => default;
			public override T GetOrNull<T>(string name) => default;
		}
	}
}
